record.bible_text: He cried<WH07121><WTH8799> also in mine ears<WH0241> with a loud<WH01419> voice<WH06963>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Cause them that have charge<WH06486> over the city<WH05892> to draw near<WH07126><WTH8804>, even every man<WH0376> <FI>with<Fi> his destroying<WH04892> weapon<WH03627> in his hand<WH03027>.

And the LORD<WH03068> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, Go through<WH05674><WTH8798> the midst<WH08432> of the city<WH05892>, through the midst<WH08432> of Jerusalem<WH03389>, and set<WH08427><WTH8689> a mark<WH08420> upon the foreheads<WH04696> of the men<WH0582> that sigh<WH0584><WTH8737> and that cry<WH0602><WTH8737> for all the abominations<WH08441> that be done<WH06213><WTH8737> in the midst<WH08432> thereof. <RF>set a mark: Heb. mark a mark<Rf><CM>

And to the others<WH0428> he said<WH0559><WTH8804> in mine hearing<WH0241>, Go<WH05674><WTH8798> ye after<WH0310> him through the city<WH05892>, and smite<WH05221><WTH8685>: let not your eye<WH05869> spare<WH02347><WTH8799>, neither have ye pity<WH02550><WTH8799>: <RF>mine hearing: Heb. mine ears<Rf>

And he said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto them, Defile<WH02930><WTH8761> the house<WH01004>, and fill<WH04390><WTH8761> the courts<WH02691> with the slain<WH02491>: go ye forth<WH03318><WTH8798>. And they went forth<WH03318><WTH8804>, and slew<WH05221><WTH8689> in the city<WH05892>.

And it came to pass, while they were slaying<WH05221><WTH8687> them, and I was left<WH07604><WTH8737>, that I fell<WH05307><WTH8799> upon my face<WH06440>, and cried<WH02199><WTH8799>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Ah<WH0162> Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>! wilt thou destroy<WH07843><WTH8688> all the residue<WH07611> of Israel<WH03478> in thy pouring out<WH08210><WTH8800> of thy fury<WH02534> upon Jerusalem<WH03389>?

Then said<WH0559><WTH8799> he unto me, The iniquity<WH05771> of the house<WH01004> of Israel<WH03478> and Judah<WH03063> <FI>is<Fi> exceeding<WH03966><WH03966> great<WH01419>, and the land<WH0776> is full<WH04390><WTH8735> of blood<WH01818>, and the city<WH05892> full<WH04390><WTH8804> of perverseness<WH04297>: for they say<WH0559><WTH8804>, The LORD<WH03068> hath forsaken<WH05800><WTH8804> the earth<WH0776>, and the LORD<WH03068> seeth<WH07200><WTH8802> not. <RF>full of blood: Heb. filled with, etc<Rf> <RF>perverseness: or, wresting of judgment<Rf>

And as for me also, mine eye<WH05869> shall not spare<WH02347><WTH8799>, neither will I have pity<WH02550><WTH8799>, <FI>but<Fi> I will recompense<WH05414><WTH8804> their way<WH01870> upon their head<WH07218>.
